identity.title: [v0.92.1][planning][sidecar] Refresh initial milestone plan before WP-28

values.goal: Audit and refresh the existing v0.92.1 planning package now, producing a reviewed initial baseline and explicit handoff that WP-28 #316 can update later.
values.required_outcome: A truthful, internally consistent initial v0.92.1 package maps six execution lanes, the #432 repository prerequisite, carryovers, dependencies, proof surfaces, readiness gaps, Runtime v4 risk, and explicit handoffs to unchanged WP-28 and v0.92.2 CodeFriend Beta 1.
declared_scope: Existing docs/milestones/v0.92.1 planning package audit and refresh
Live v0.92/v0.92.1 issue and dependency inventory
Operator-authorized promotion of validated Axum configuration hot reload
Podcast publication and Podcast Studio lane allocation
Observatory redesign sprint allocation without Runtime backend expansion
Initial work-package, proof, readiness, and handoff reconciliation
authority_boundary: This sidecar creates an initial planning baseline only
WP-28 #316 remains unchanged and owns the later plan update
No issue migration, product implementation, release approval, or milestone activation
Runtime v4 remains a named risk and is not committed scope
operator_constraints: Use typed C-SDLC v2 and a dedicated FastWork worktree
Promote only the explicitly authorized Axum hot-reload item; do not promote other backlog items or move issues
Do not create tracked dependencies on .adl paths
Use focused docs/YAML/link/routing validation rather than broad Rust tests
